19:12 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The 76ers host the Cavaliers in an NBA regular-season game at Xfinity Mobile Arena. The Cavaliers has won four of its last five games against the 76ers. James Harden leads the Cavaliers into another season, while the 76ers relies on Tyrese Maxey.
